title: docs(pm-skill): Enterprise cloud-lane cards take their dispatch order from cloud/ROADMAP.md, and the director re-reads the table weekly
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbB7efidz8HPtTbEjf8TCaSE)_

Fixes #31574

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:企业版相关卡在云车道的派发次序改为以 `cloud/ROADMAP.md` 的档位与行序为准,席位不在单卡上另调;总监席每周复读该表,把三类不一致列给您。
- 为什么改:落实您在 cloud#3835 第 6 项的原话;该表已写明「席位按表读、不逐卡改序」,但车队规则里没有一条让它生效。
- 风险与回滚:只改两份席位规则文件各 4 行,不动代码、门禁与 workflow;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 新增两行(取卡全序之下);`references/lanes/director.md` 职责四新增两行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`,预期两份文件仍在上限内(188/188、86/86)且全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `references/execution-duties.md`: the rule lives here once, right under the pick order (`取卡全序` / `标签序`) every execution seat reads each fire. An Enterprise card in the cloud lane is picked in the tier and row order of `cloud/ROADMAP.md`; a seat does not reorder on a single card; a priority change is an edit to that table, made by or for the maintainer, with the ruling linked; the pointer is that file's "Maintaining this file" section. No rows are copied.
- `references/lanes/director.md` (duty four): the director re-reads the table on the week's first sitting and lists for the maintainer a closed card still shown as in development, an open Enterprise card missing from the table, and a table order that disagrees with card priorities. Once the cloud drift-check script exists, the re-read runs it. It is a report, not a gate: no CI check, workflow or script is added.
- `seat-lifecycle.md` L57 (epic order = the roadmap table, cloud: `cloud/ROADMAP.md`) already agrees and is left as is; it orders epics, the new line orders cards.
- Both files sat at their line ceilings. Four lines restated elsewhere pay for the four new ones:
  - execution-duties.md, card-assignee line: survives at `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:36,38`, `AGENTS.md:403-404`, `references/project-forms.md:31`.
  - execution-duties.md, gate-list line: survives at `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:139,145,160,169`.
  - director.md, missing-pieces line: survives at `references/execution-duties.md:21`, `SKILL.md:201`, `AGENTS.md:289`, `references/lanes/director.md:39`.
  - director.md, seat-post liveness pointer: survives at `references/dispatch-runbook.md:39,41`, `references/triage-duties.md:82`.
- No line was re-wrapped; every new line is at most 120 bytes.

## Tests

No code changed. The 17 derived gates ran at `0ed89549`, all exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` accounts for 17 of 17, 0 NOT MEASURED.
